post.description:
Create a new Confluence page. Supply the spaceId and an optional parentId to nest the page under an existing one. Page body content should use storage (HTML-like) format. To create blog posts, use the separate /wiki/api/v2/blogposts endpoint. Request body: Body: {spaceId (required, string — numeric space ID), title (required, string), body (required, object — {representation: 'storage', value: '

HTML content

'}), parentId (optional, string — parent page ID for nested pages), status (optional, string — 'current' or 'draft', default 'current')}.

schema.description:
Body: {spaceId (required, string — numeric space ID), title (required, string), body (required, object — {representation: 'storage', value: '

HTML content

'}), parentId (optional, string — parent page ID for nested pages), status (optional, string — 'current' or 'draft', default 'current')}

value.description: Page content as an HTML or storage-format string.

body.description: In API v2 responses, the body uses a flat structure: {representation, value}. It is not nested under 'storage'.

webui.description: URL to open the page in the Confluence web interface.

status.description: 'current' indicates the page is published and visible.

parentId.description: Identifier of the parent page; null for top-level pages.
